args.sql: SELECT di.devregistry, di.makername, di.modnum, ts.pollratehz, ts.inplagms, ts.resptimems, ic.joyprec, ic.driftres, ic.trigres, ic.hapstr FROM deviceidentity di JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref LIMIT 5;

SELECT di.makername, di.modnum, ts.pollratehz, ts.inplagms, ts.resptimems, 
       (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 AS irs_score,
       ic.joyprec, ic.driftres, ic.trigres, ic.hapstr
FROM deviceidentity di 
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry 
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref 
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    di.makername AS manufacturer,
    di.modnum AS model,
    ROUND(CAST((ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 AS numeric), 2) AS irs_score,
    ic.joyprec,
    ic.driftres,
    ic.trigres,
    ic.hapstr,
    CASE WHEN 
        (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 > 8.0
        AND ic.joyprec > 9.0
        AND ic.driftres > 9.5
        AND ic.trigres >= 5
        AND ic.hapstr > 8
    THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS meets_professional_standards
FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref
WHERE 
    (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 > 8.0
    AND ic.joyprec > 9.0
    AND ic.driftres > 9.5
    AND ic.trigres >= 5
    AND ic.hapstr > 8
ORDER BY irs_score DESC;

-- Maybe the formula is: PollRateHz/100 * (30 - InpLagMs - RespTimeMs) / 30
-- Without the * 10, and threshold is different
-- Let me check what threshold gives 176
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref
WHERE 
    (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) > 0.8
    AND ic.joyprec > 9.0
    AND ic.driftres > 9.5
    AND ic.trigres >= 5
    AND ic.hapstr >= 8;

-- Try >= 0.8
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref
WHERE 
    (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) >= 0.8
    AND ic.joyprec > 9.0
    AND ic.driftres > 9.5
    AND ic.trigres >= 5
    AND ic.hapstr >= 8;

-- Check for devices with joyprec exactly 9.0 (unlikely but let's verify)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interactionandcontrol WHERE joyprec = 9.0;

-- Check for devices with driftres exactly 9.5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interactionandcontrol WHERE driftres = 9.5;

-- Try IRS with clklat from performance, and >= for all thresholds
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref
JOIN performance p ON ts.sessionregistry = p.perfsessionref
WHERE 
    (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (p.clklat + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 > 8.0
    AND ic.joyprec > 9.0
    AND ic.driftres > 9.5
    AND ic.trigres >= 5
    AND ic.hapstr >= 8;

-- Try with >= 8.0 and clklat
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref
JOIN performance p ON ts.sessionregistry = p.perfsessionref
WHERE 
    (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (p.clklat + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 >= 8.0
    AND ic.joyprec > 9.0
    AND ic.driftres > 9.5
    AND ic.trigres >= 5
    AND ic.hapstr >= 8;

-- Try with >= 8.0, joyprec >= 9.0, driftres >= 9.5, trigres >= 5, hapstr >= 8
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deviceidentity di
JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON di.devregistry = ic.interactdevref
WHERE 
    (ts.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 >= 8.0
    AND ic.joyprec >= 9.0
    AND ic.driftres >= 9.5
    AND ic.trigres >= 5
    AND ic.hapstr >= 8;
